commits.author: Choi wontak
commits.subject: fix(session): change freshContext default to false for session continuity
commits.body:
Previously, freshContext defaulted to true, causing each new message in
a thread to start a fresh OpenCode session — losing conversation context.
Users expect 'same thread = same conversation' behavior by default.

Closes #27

commits.subject: feat(session): add /session command to browse and attach CLI sessions from Discord
commits.body:
Add a new /session slash command with list, attach, detach, and info
subcommands, allowing users to resume OpenCode CLI sessions from Discord
threads. Sessions display titles from the OpenCode API for easy
identification.

- Add SessionInfo interface and getSessionInfo() to sessionManager
- Update listSessions() to return {id, title} instead of just IDs
- Create session.ts with list/attach/detach/info subcommands
- Register session command in commands/index.ts

Closes #25

commits.subject: fix(model): prevent autocomplete timeout crash on cold cache
commits.body:
- Pre-warm model cache on bot startup to avoid cold execSync in autocomplete
- Reduce execSync timeout from 5s to 2s (Discord allows 3s for autocomplete)
- Export getCachedModels for startup pre-warming
- Wrap fallback respond([]) in try/catch to prevent crash on expired interaction

commits.subject: fix(model): use async cache refresh to prevent autocomplete timeout
commits.body:
- On cache miss with existing stale data, refresh asynchronously via exec()
  and return stale results immediately (never blocks autocomplete)
- Only use blocking execSync for first-ever cache population (bot startup)
- Wrap autocomplete respond() in try/catch for resilience against expired interactions
